messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: CobaltLogic technical concordance review & runbook

Hi Alex & Priya,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the integration. As discussed in today's kickoff, we'd like to lock down a short technical concordance review and an accompanying runbook so both teams can run the reference flows end-to-end in your sandbox and our staging. High-level asks for this thread:

- Confirm the reference architecture (attached drawio) and any deviations.
- Provide a brief network/security checklist (egress IPs, required ports, TLS/KMS expectations).
- Agree on the smoke/interop test plan and acceptance criteria (token throughput, latency targets, memory footprint).
- Identify who will run the initial canary and when (target: week of Nov 22).

I've CC'd Laura to own the runbook and Karthik for test harnesses. Vivek will help with the deployment checklist if we need a private deployment template.

Attachments: cobalt_ref_arch.drawio.png (diagram), interop-test-runbook.md (skeleton), network-reqs.pdf (initial ask).

Next step: Alex, can you confirm any deviations from the attached ref arch and share the sandbox cluster specs (GPUs, AMI/container image ids)? If possible, please prefer the upstream container image tag we discussed (redwood/serving:2026-10-20-quant).

Thanks,
Sergio
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

--
Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cobaltlogic.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@cobaltlogic.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: CobaltLogic technical concordance review & runbook

Sergio — thanks, this looks good. Quick answers up front:

- We reviewed the draw.io. The only deviation is that our inference layer currently sits behind an internal sidecar that handles authentication and request throttling — we can flip that to passthrough for the tests.
- Sandbox cluster: 2x A10G (24GB) + 4x T4 (16GB) for orchestration. We're running a custom container image but we can drop in redwood/serving:2026-10-20-quant for the canary.
- Network: we'll open outbound HTTPS to the Redwood egress IP block (I'll send a list in a follow-up).

I've attached a draft of the interop-runbook with a few notes inline. Priya will coordinate the SOC2/attestation evidence you asked about for production later in the process.

Proposed schedule:
- Finalize runbook by Nov 12
- Smoke tests in sandbox Nov 16-18
- Canary in our staging Nov 22-24

I'll loop in our infra lead if you want deeper kernel-level perf numbers; otherwise this should be sufficient to start.

Cheers,
Alex Turner
CTO, CobaltLogic
alex.turner@cobaltlogic.com | +1 212-555-0147

Attachments: interop-test-runbook.md (edited)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@cobaltlogic.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@cobaltlogic.com>

Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CobaltLogic technical concordance review & runbook (runbook draft & checklist)

Alex / Priya — attaching an updated runbook (I pulled Alex's inline notes) and added an acceptance criteria matrix. Highlights:

- Reference flow: client request -> CobaltLogic sidecar -> Redwood serving container -> response. We will validate both passthrough and sidecar modes.
- Perf targets (smoke): median latency < 250ms @ 8 concurrent streams, sustained 1200 tokens/s aggregate across the A10G pair (512-token prompts).
- Memory guidance: quantized LLM variants should fit within 20GB VRAM for single-GPU inference; model sharding required above 30B parameters.
- Security: TLS mutual auth for production; sandbox will use one-way TLS. We'll need the egress IP list and your KMS key policy for CI access.

Action items assigned in the doc:
- Alex: provide egress IP block + sandbox kube config (by Nov 11)
- Priya: SOC2 evidence pointer (by Nov 12)
- Karthik: finalize harness container and perf script (by Nov 13)
- Vivek: private deploy template changes (if needed) (by Nov 13)

If you want, we can add a short regression checklist for the model output quality check (fuzzy matching on golden prompts).

Laura Bennett
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: interop-test-runbook.md (v2), network-reqs.pdf

Laura / Sergio — all good from our side. Quick notes:

- Egress IPs: sending to your firewall team in a separate secure email (should arrive today).
- Kubeconfig: shared to the Drive link you listed.
- SOC2 pointer: Priya will share the attestation doc on Nov 13; for now our sandbox uses one-way TLS.
- Regarding the sidecar: we've scheduled a brief change to run passthrough mode during the Nov 16 smoke window; we'll revert after tests.

We're prepared to proceed with the Nov 16-18 smoke plan and Nov 22 canary. Once Karthik posts the harness image tag I'll trigger the jobs and report results back to this thread.

I'll attach the final copy of the runbook after I sync with Priya (see attached drawio & runbook).

Thanks — Alex
CTO, CobaltLogic
